labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Synclounge is a third party tool that allows you to watch Plex in sync with your friends/family, wherever you are.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.ref.name: 809c5810b5f69228898d5fcfc087eb89d5a2ecf5
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Synclounge

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver/baseimage-alpine:3.24

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG SYNCLOUNGE_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="alex-phillips"

# environment settings
ENV HOME="/app"
WORKDIR /app

RUN \
  echo "**** install build packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    nodejs && \
  apk add --no-cache --virtual=build-dependencies \
    build-base \
    git \
    npm && \
  echo "**** install SyncLounge ****" && \
  if [ -z ${SYNCLOUNGE_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    SYNCLOUNGE_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://registry.npmjs.org/synclounge/" \
      | jq -r '."dist-tags".latest'); \
  fi && \
  npm install -g --omit=dev synclounge@"$SYNCLOUNGE_RELEASE" && \
  npm prune --omit=dev && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apk del --purge \
    build-dependencies && \
  rm -rf \
    $HOME/.cache \
    /tmp/*

# copy local files
COPY root/ /
dockerfile.arm64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver/baseimage-alpine:arm64v8-3.24

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG SYNCLOUNGE_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="alex-phillips"

# environment settings
ENV HOME="/app"
WORKDIR /app

RUN \
  echo "**** install build packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    nodejs && \
  apk add --no-cache --virtual=build-dependencies \
    build-base \
    npm \
    python3-dev && \
  echo "**** install SyncLounge ****" && \
  if [ -z ${SYNCLOUNGE_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    SYNCLOUNGE_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://registry.npmjs.org/synclounge/" \
      | jq -r '."dist-tags".latest'); \
  fi && \
  npm install -g --omit=dev synclounge@"$SYNCLOUNGE_RELEASE" --unsafe && \
  npm prune --omit=dev && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apk del --purge \
    build-dependencies && \
  rm -rf \
    $HOME/.cache \
    /tmp/*

# copy local files
COPY root/ /

units.name: svc-synclounge
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

if [ -n "${AUTH_LIST}" ]; then
    export authentication__mechanism='["plex"]'
    export authentication__type='["server", "user"]'
    export authentication__authorized="[\"$(echo ${AUTH_LIST} | sed 's|,|", "|g')\"]"
fi

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 8088" \
            s6-setuidgid abc synclounge
else
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 8088" \
            synclounge
fi
